summary: The game establishes a playable 3D laser tag prototype with undulating San Francisco hills, Victorian-inspired facades, and active AI opponents. However, heavy white fog severely washes out the visuals (violating the crisp daytime requirement), the camera is awkwardly tilted, 3D opponent nameplates scale up to block the entire screen when close, and the car models are overly boxy.

top_issues.issue: Heavy white fog/haze washes out the scene and reduces contrast, directly violating the rubric requirement for 'clear sunny daytime, crisp contrast, NO fog or haze'.
top_issues.evidence: All screenshots (0 to 5) and throughout the video (00:00-00:37) show a thick white haze obscuring buildings and the Golden Gate Bridge just two blocks away, with a completely white sky.
top_issues.fix_hint: Remove scene fog completely, add a vibrant blue skybox with sunny directional lighting, and increase material contrast and shadow crispness.

top_issues.issue: 3D world-space nameplates above opponent Waymos do not clamp their screen size, growing massive and obstructing the player's view when close.
top_issues.evidence: Video at 00:14-00:15 and Screenshot 2 show the 'WAYMO-SF12' label filling nearly the entire width of the screen as the player passes the opponent.
top_issues.fix_hint: Clamp the maximum screen-space scale of 3D billboarding UI labels or fade them out when within close proximity to the camera.

top_issues.issue: Severe geometry clipping and floating buildings on hill slopes, plus a permanently Dutch-tilted camera angle.
top_issues.evidence: Screenshot 0 and Screenshot 1 (top-left) show a tan building mesh floating/clipping in mid-air above the left sidewalk; the camera horizon is tilted ~10 degrees clockwise throughout the entire video.
top_issues.fix_hint: Keep the camera horizon level (or only subtly roll during sharp turns) and extend building foundations downward so they sink cleanly into sloped terrain.

top_issues.issue: Car models are blocky, flat-sided boxes rather than sleek Jaguar I-PACE SUVs with sloped coupe rooflines and distinct corner/mirror sensor pods.
top_issues.evidence: Player car visible in Screenshots 0-5 has vertical boxy rear/sides, no rear windshield detail or taillights, and green hexagon particle artifacts floating around the chassis (Screenshots 3-5).
top_issues.fix_hint: Shape the car body with a sloped coupe rear, add dark glass windows, distinct taillights, Waymo door branding, and prominent corner fender/mirror sensor pods.

top_issues.issue: Only one landmark (Golden Gate Bridge) is visible, and it sits right at the end of the city street grid rather than across a bay, while other iconic SF landmarks are absent.
top_issues.evidence: Screenshots 0-5 show the orange Golden Gate Bridge tower directly at the end of the street; no Transamerica Pyramid, Salesforce Tower, Coit/Sutro Tower, or cable cars are visible.
top_issues.fix_hint: Place the Golden Gate Bridge and Bay Bridge over water outside the street grid, and add skyline landmarks like the Transamerica Pyramid, Salesforce Tower, and Coit Tower visible from the hills.

top_issues.issue: Heavy white fog/haze washes out the entire scene and sky, violating the requirement for clear sunny daytime with crisp contrast and NO fog or haze.
top_issues.evidence: Screenshots 0-5 and throughout the video (00:00-00:37) show dense white distance fog obscuring the sky, buildings, and Golden Gate Bridge.
top_issues.fix_hint: Remove scene.fog completely, add a clear blue skybox or sky dome, and increase directional sunlight contrast.

top_issues.issue: A large building or wall geometry on the left side clips into the roadway/sidewalk and floats in front of the background buildings at an awkward angle.
top_issues.evidence: Screenshot 0 and Screenshot 1 (top-left quadrant) show a beige building wall cutting straight across the left street view.
top_issues.fix_hint: Fix building placement and alignment along sloped terrain so buildings sit cleanly on city blocks behind sidewalks without intersecting roads.

top_issues.issue: Enemy 3D nameplates ('WAYMO-SF12') scale up to enormous sizes when close to the camera, blocking the player's view.
top_issues.evidence: Video 00:13-00:15 and Screenshot 2 show the 'WAYMO-SF12' label covering a huge portion of the screen.
top_issues.fix_hint: Clamp the maximum screen-space size of 3D billboard labels or fade them out when very close to the camera.
